Arab Kings.
He commanded those who buy and sell women's handiwork
to go round from house to house,
and that a woman should open her door
and buy and sell without uncovering her face or her hands,
but should hold out her handiwork with a shovel,
and with the very same take the price.
Indeed, for a woman to go outside
or go to the bathhouse,
he did not permit at all.
And thus it remained until he was killed.
And in this year, which is the year 1325 [of the Greeks],
peoples of the Chinese [Kitai]—
while those alone who are called Kitai were two hundred thousand,
and these others from thirty thousand
and from fifty thousand—
came to the country of the Turks {Huns},
and Ahmad bar Ali bar Qarakhan, the ruler of Bukhara, met them and broke them,
and plundered their tents,
and inherited vessels of gold and silver and bolts of silk without number.
It is said
that their bows were a span longer than usual,
and likewise their arrows.
And in the year
410 of the Arabs, when the son of Qarakhan, the ruler of Bukhara, died,
there arose after him another, his brother {OCR?}, Khwarazmshah Mahmud bar Sabuktigin.
And he went to India,
and subdued many cities there,
and took great plunder, and returned.
And in the year 411,
411 of the Arabs,
when the Egyptians were put in great distress by the Caliph Hakim,
and hatred of him increased in their hearts,
certain shrewd men among them devised a plan,
and wrote insulting {OCR?} documents, full of mockeries and reproaches, against him and against his women,
and sealed them, and held them out to him at night when he was riding,
and would hide away.
It is said
that they made out of paper {OCR?} the likeness of a woman who held out her hand,
and between her fingers was a document.
And they set her up at night in one of the corners where Hakim was passing,
and covered her with a veil of white paper.
And when he passed and saw her, he was enraged,
and commanded his slaves to hack her to pieces with swords.
And when they approached and saw that she was an effigy,
they informed him,
and gave him the document that was in her hand.
And when he opened it and read it {OCR?}, he found in it an abundance of shameful words concerning his virgin sister.
